import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1050;
    static int Mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] f = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] g = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][][] dp = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][2];

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        return a + b >= Mod ? a + b - Mod : a + b;
    }

    static int sub_mod(int a, int b) {
        return a - b < 0 ? a - b + Mod : a - b;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % Mod);
    }

    static void combine(int[] x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            x[i] = add_mod(x[i], y);
        }
    }

    static int combine(int a, int b) {
        return add_mod(a, b);
    }

    static void precompute_combinations(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                C[i][j] = add_mod(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        Mod = sc.nextInt();

        f[1] = 2;
        g[1] = 0;
        int limit = Math.max(m, n - m + 1);
        precompute_combinations(limit);

        for (int i = 2; i <= m; ++i) {
            f[i] = mul_mod(f[i - 1], 2 * (i + 1));
            g[i] = mul_mod(g[i - 1], 2 * (i + 1));
            int[] tempG = new int[MAX_SIZE];
            System.arraycopy(g, 0, tempG, 0, g.length);
            combine(tempG, mul_mod(f[i - 1], i * (i - 1)));
            System.arraycopy(tempG, 0, g, 0, g.length);
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                int k = i - j - 1;
                int c = mul_mod(C[j + k][j], j + k + 2);
                int[] tempF = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                System.arraycopy(f, 0, tempF, 0, f.length);
                int[] tempG2 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                System.arraycopy(g, 0, tempG2, 0, g.length);
                combine(f, mul_mod(c, mul_mod(tempF[j], tempF[k])));
                combine(g, mul_mod(c, mul_mod(tempF[j], tempG2[k])));
                combine(g, mul_mod(c, mul_mod(tempG2[j], tempF[k])));
                int w = j * (j + 1) / 2 + k * (k + 1) / 2;
                int[] tempF2 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                System.arraycopy(f, 0, tempF2, 0, f.length);
                int[] tempG3 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                System.arraycopy(g, 0, tempG3, 0, g.length);
                combine(g, mul_mod(mul_mod(C[j + k][j], w), mul_mod(tempF2[j], tempF2[k])));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j)
                for (int o = 0; o < 2; ++o)
                    dp[i][j][o] = 0;

        dp[0][0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                for (int o = 0; o < 2; ++o) {
                    int c = dp[i][j][o];
                    if (c != 0) {
                        if (o == 0) {
                            for (int k = 1; k + j <= m; ++k) {
                                int[] tempDP1 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                                System.arraycopy(dp[i + 1], 0, tempDP1, 0, MAX_SIZE);
                                combine(tempDP1[j + k], mul_mod(mul_mod(c, C[j + k][k]), f[k]));
                                System.arraycopy(tempDP1, 0, dp[i + 1][j + k], 0, MAX_SIZE);

                                int[] tempDP2 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                                System.arraycopy(dp[i + 1], 0, tempDP2, 0, MAX_SIZE);
                                combine(tempDP2[j + k], mul_mod(mul_mod(c, C[j + k][k]), g[k]));
                                System.arraycopy(tempDP2, 0, dp[i + 1][j + k], 0, MAX_SIZE);
                            }
                        } else {
                            for (int k = 1; k + j <= m; ++k) {
                                int[] tempDP2 = new int[MAX_SIZE];
                                System.arraycopy(dp[i + 1], 0, tempDP2, 0, MAX_SIZE);
                                combine(tempDP2[j + k], mul_mod(mul_mod(c, C[j + k][k]), f[k]));
                                System.arraycopy(tempDP2, 0, dp[i + 1][j + k], 0, MAX_SIZE);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            total = combine(total, mul_mod(dp[i][m][1], C[n - m + 1][i]));
        }

        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
